mapper.sql: c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND c.review_status='APPROVED' AND c.source_version_status NOT IN ('SUSPECT','STALE') AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs r LEFT JOIN code_chunks current_chunk ON current_chunk.repo_id=r.repo_id AND current_chunk.file_path=r.file_path AND current_chunk.start_line=r.start_line AND current_chunk.content_hash=r.content_hash AND current_chunk.snapshot_id=( SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=r.repo_id ) WHERE r.card_id=c.id AND r.revision=c.revision AND current_chunk.id IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT ,0.0 lexical_score, GREATEST(0.0,1-(e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))) semantic_score FROM knowledge_card_embeddings e JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=e.card_id AND c.revision=e.revision WHERE AND e.model=#{model} AND e.dimension=#{dimension} ORDER BY e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector),c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_conversations( id,thread_id,turn_no,repo_id,account_id,client_request_id,title,question,answer,snapshot_id, provider,evidence_status,fallback_reason,answer_payload,status,finished_at ) VALUES( #{id},#{threadId},#{turnNo},#{repositoryId},#{accountId},#{clientRequestId},#{title},#{question},#{answer},#{snapshotId}, #{provider},#{evidenceStatus},#{fallbackReason},CAST(#{answerPayload} AS jsonb),'COMPLETED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id,thread_id,turn_no,repo_id,account_id,title,question,answer,snapshot_id,provider,evidence_status, fallback_reason,answer_payload,status,created_at,updated_at FROM qa_conversations WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}

SELECT c.id,c.thread_id,c.turn_no,c.repo_id,c.account_id,c.title,c.question,c.answer,c.snapshot_id,c.provider,c.evidence_status, c.fallback_reason,c.answer_payload,c.status,c.created_at,c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_citations q WHERE q.conversation_id=c.id) citation_count FROM qa_conversations c WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.account_id=#{accountId}

SELECT c.id,c.thread_id,c.turn_no,c.repo_id,c.account_id,c.title,c.question,c.answer,c.snapshot_id,c.provider,c.evidence_status, c.fallback_reason,c.answer_payload,c.status,c.created_at,c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_citations q JOIN qa_conversations t ON t.id=q.conversation_id WHERE t.thread_id=c.thread_id) citation_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_conversations t WHERE t.thread_id=c.thread_id) turn_count FROM qa_conversations c WHERE c.thread_id=#{threadId} AND c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY c.turn_no LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id,c.thread_id,c.turn_no,c.repo_id,c.account_id,c.title,c.question,c.answer,c.snapshot_id,c.provider,c.evidence_status, c.fallback_reason,c.answer_payload,c.status,c.created_at,c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_citations q WHERE q.conversation_id=c.id) citation_count FROM qa_conversations c WHERE c.thread_id=#{threadId} AND c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY c.turn_no
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(turn_no),0)+1 FROM qa_conversations WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}

SELECT latest.thread_id AS id,latest.thread_id,latest.repo_id,latest.title,latest.question, latest.provider,latest.evidence_status,latest.fallback_reason, stats.citation_count,stats.turn_count,stats.created_at,stats.updated_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (thread_id) thread_id,repo_id,title,question,provider,evidence_status,fallback_reason FROM qa_conversations WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY thread_id,turn_no DESC ) latest JOIN ( SELECT c.thread_id,COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) turn_count,COUNT(q.id) citation_count, MIN(c.created_at) created_at,MAX(c.updated_at) updated_at FROM qa_conversations c LEFT JOIN qa_citations q ON q.conversation_id=c.id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.account_id=#{accountId} GROUP BY c.thread_id ) stats ON stats.thread_id=latest.thread_id ORDER BY stats.updated_at DESC,latest.thread_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_conversations SET title=#{title},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE thread_id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM qa_conversations WHERE thread_id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT source_symbol,target_symbol,relation FROM heuristic_call_edges WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND snapshot_id=(SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId}) LIMIT 500
SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM heuristic_call_edges WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND snapshot_id=(SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT id,snapshot_id,symbol_name,content FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND snapshot_id=(SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=#{repositoryId}) AND symbol_name IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO heuristic_call_edges(id,repo_id,snapshot_id,source_chunk_id,target_chunk_id,source_symbol,target_symbol,relation) VALUES(#{id},#{repositoryId},#{snapshotId},#{sourceChunkId},#{targetChunkId},#{sourceSymbol},#{targetSymbol},'CALLS') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,knowledge_kind,severity,enforcement, owner_account_id,scope_payload::text AS scope_payload, obligations_payload::text AS obligations_payload,last_verified_snapshot_id,verification_note, publication_status,revision,created_at,updated_at, verified_commit,source_version_status,source_version_checked_at,review_status,reviewed_by,reviewed_at FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND review_status='APPROVED' AND source_version_status NOT IN ('SUSPECT','STALE') ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET title=#{title},card_type=#{cardType},content=#{content}, tags=#{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler},knowledge_kind=#{knowledgeKind}, severity=#{severity},enforcement=#{enforcement},owner_account_id=#{ownerAccountId}, scope_payload=CAST(#{scopePayload} AS jsonb),obligations_payload=CAST(#{obligationsPayload} AS jsonb), publication_status='DRAFT', review_status='UNREVIEWED',reviewed_by=NULL,reviewed_at=NULL, source_version_status='UNVERIFIED',verified_commit=NULL,source_version_checked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_verified_snapshot_id=NULL,verification_note=NULL, revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId}

UPDATE knowledge_cards c SET source_version_status=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs ref WHERE ref.card_id=c.id AND ref.revision=c.revision ) THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'UNVERIFIED' END, verified_commit=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs ref WHERE ref.card_id=c.id AND ref.revision=c.revision ) THEN (SELECT current_commit FROM repositories WHERE id=c.repo_id) ELSE NULL END, last_verified_snapshot_id=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs ref WHERE ref.card_id=c.id AND ref.revision=c.revision ) THEN (SELECT current_snapshot_id FROM repositories WHERE id=c.repo_id) ELSE NULL END, verification_note=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs ref WHERE ref.card_id=c.id AND ref.revision=c.revision ) THEN '关联代码已在当前快照中核验' ELSE NULL END, source_version_checked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.repo_id=#{repositoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(c.id,r.chunk_id) chunk_id,COALESCE(c.snapshot_id,r.snapshot_id) snapshot_id, r.file_path,COALESCE(c.symbol_name,r.symbol_name) symbol_name,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash, (c.id IS NULL) stale FROM knowledge_code_refs r LEFT JOIN code_chunks c ON c.repo_id=r.repo_id AND c.file_path=r.file_path AND c.start_line=r.start_line AND c.content_hash=r.content_hash WHERE r.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND r.card_id=#{cardId} AND r.revision=#{revision} ORDER BY r.position
SELECT setting_key,CASE WHEN sensitive THEN '******' ELSE setting_value END value FROM system_settings ORDER BY setting_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,updated_by) VALUES(#{key},#{value},#{actorId}) ON CONFLICT(setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value=EXCLUDED.setting_value, updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.revision,CONCAT(c.title,E'\n',c.content,E'\n',ARRAY_TO_STRING(c.tags,' ')) content FROM knowledge_cards c LEFT JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings e ON e.card_id=c.id WHERE AND(e.card_id IS NULL OR e.revision<>c.revision OR e.model<>#{model} OR e.dimension<>#{dimension} OR e.retrieval_capability<>#{capability})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_card_embeddings(card_id,repo_id,revision,model,dimension,retrieval_capability,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{cardId},#{repositoryId},#{revision},#{model},#{dimension},#{capability},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(card_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=EXCLUDED.revision,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, model=EXCLUDED.model,dimension=EXCLUDED.dimension,retrieval_capability=EXCLUDED.retrieval_capability, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash, created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO chunk_embeddings(chunk_id,repo_id,model,dimension,retrieval_capability,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{chunkId},#{repositoryId},#{model},#{dimension},#{capability},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET model=EXCLUDED.model,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, dimension=EXCLUDED.dimension,retrieval_capability=EXCLUDED.retrieval_capability, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
